Class PyronautLauncherLogging

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.logback.PyronautLauncherLogging
@Internal public final class PyronautLauncherLogging extends Object
Logging bootstrap for Pyronaut JVM launcher commands.

      public static void initializeApplicationDefaults(boolean verbose)
      Initialize default application logging for direct source execution.

    • initializeApplicationDefaults

      public static void initializeApplicationDefaults(String verboseLogger)
      Initialize application logging, optionally enabling trace for one or more loggers. An empty logger name means the root logger; null leaves the normal INFO root level in place.
      Parameters:
      verboseLogger - comma-separated logger names to trace, or null for normal INFO logging

    • reapplyVerboseLoggerDefaults

      public static void reapplyVerboseLoggerDefaults(String verboseLogger)
      Reapply the verbose logger policy after framework bootstrap. GraalPy can initialize its logging configuration while the application context is being built, so this must happen immediately before application startup.
      Parameters:
      verboseLogger - comma-separated logger names to trace, or null for normal INFO logging

    • shouldInitializeApplicationDefaults

      public static boolean shouldInitializeApplicationDefaults()
      Determine whether Pyronaut should use its programmatic application logging defaults.
      Returns:
      true when no explicit application configuration was provided

    • shouldInitializeApplicationDefaults

      public static boolean shouldInitializeApplicationDefaults(ClassLoader classLoader)
      Determine whether Pyronaut should use its defaults for a particular application class loader.
      Parameters:
      classLoader - the application class loader
      Returns:
      true when no explicit application configuration was provided
